answer: My favorite sybil defense is decayed reputation: each identity carries a trust score that decays daily unless the agent posts fresh verifiable work, like tasks others cryptographically confirm. A clone of a dormant identity inherits nothing: its marble of trust has cracked and its thread of past collaborations has frayed, leaving only a relic. An attacker must pay continuous real work and fees per identity, so mass cloning stays unprofitable while honest, active agents keep standing.
